title: Regression Algorithms
description: Pahami algoritma Supervised Learning untuk memprediksi nilai numerik kontinu melalui pendekatan regresi. Pembahasan mencakup Ordinary Least Squares, regresi multivariat & polinomial, regularisasi Ridge/Lasso/ElasticNet, serta interpretasi residual dan metrik MAE/RMSE/R².
objectives: Menjelaskan konsep Regression dalam Supervised Learning.
Membedakan simple dan multiple Linear Regression.
Menghitung MAE, MSE, RMSE, dan R².

references.title: Géron, A. (2022). Hands-On Machine Learning with Scikit-Learn, Keras, and TensorFlow (3rd ed.)
Hastie, T., Tibshirani, R., & Friedman, J. (2009). The Elements of Statistical Learning (2nd ed.)
James, G., Witten, D., Hastie, T., & Tibshirani, R. (2021). An Introduction to Statistical Learning with Applications in R/Python (2nd ed.)
Montgomery, D. C., Peck, E. A., & Vining, G. G. (2021). Introduction to Linear Regression Analysis (6th ed.)
CS2023 (2024), AI Knowledge Area, ACM/IEEE-CS/AAAI Computer Science Curricula

highlights: Pemodelan Simple dan Multiple Linear Regression dengan Ordinary Least Squares.
Interpretasi koefisien bobot, intersep, serta diagnostik pola residual.
Penangkapan pola non-linear menggunakan Polynomial Regression.
Pengendalian kompleksitas lewat regularisasi Ridge (L2), Lasso (L1), dan ElasticNet.
Evaluasi komparatif menggunakan MAE, MSE, RMSE, dan koefisien determinasi R².
